 "cells": [
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Hysteresis JV simulation"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Test inputs for SimSS: version matches SIMsalabim 5.37\n",
      "Test inputs for ZimT: version matches SIMsalabim 5.37\n",
      "Copying the SimSS test inputs to /home/lecorre/Desktop/pySIMsalabim/SIMsalabim/SimSS\n",
      "Copying the ZimT test inputs to /home/lecorre/Desktop/pySIMsalabim/SIMsalabim/ZimT\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import os, sys\n",
    "try:\n",
    "    import pySIMsalabim as sim\n",
    "except ImportError: # add parent directory to sys.path if pySIMsalabim is not installed\n",
    "    sys.path.append('..')\n",
    "    import pySIMsalabim as sim\n",
    "from pySIMsalabim.experiments.hysteresis import *\n",
    "\n",
    "# Use the default input files shipped with the pySIMsalabim tests (pySIMsalabim/tests/sim_inputs/default):\n",
    "# check that they match the SIMsalabim version and copy them into SIMsalabim/SimSS and SIMsalabim/ZimT\n",
    "sys.path.append(os.path.join('..', 'pySIMsalabim', 'tests'))\n",
    "from sim_inputs_setup import prepare_test_inputs, cleanup_test_inputs\n",
    "prepare_test_inputs(convert=False)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### Setup the simulation"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Set the path to the simulation setup file\n",
    "cwd = os.path.abspath('..')\n",
    "session_path = os.path.join(cwd, 'SIMsalabim','ZimT')\n",
    "zimt_device_parameters = os.path.join(session_path, 'simulation_setup_test.txt')\n",
    "\n",
    "# Set the hysteresis simulation parameters\n",
    "scan_speed = 10\n",
    "direction = -1\n",
    "G_frac = 1\n",
    "tVG_name = os.path.join(session_path,'tVG.txt')\n",
    "Vmin = 0.0\n",
    "Vmax = 1.25\n",
    "steps = 200\n",
    "# Run the hysteresis simulation\n",
    "ret, mess, rms = Hysteresis_JV(zimt_device_parameters, session_path, 0, scan_speed, direction, G_frac, tVG_name, run_mode=False, Vmin=Vmin, Vmax=Vmax, steps = steps, expJV_Vmin_Vmax='', expJV_Vmax_Vmin='',rms_mode='lin',threadsafe=False)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### Plot results"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 640x480 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "ax = plot_hysteresis_JV(session_path)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "# Clean up the output files (comment out if you want to keep the output files)\n",
    "sim.clean_all_output(session_path)\n",
    "sim.delete_folders('tmp',session_path)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Remove the test input files copied into the SIMsalabim folder\n",
    "cleanup_test_inputs()"
   ]
  }
 ],
